title: Trent Williams tries to "soak it in" as he nears end of career

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Trent Williams tries to "soak it in" as he nears end of career
sources.description: When left tackle Trent Williams agreed to a new two-year contract with the 49ers this offseason, he said he believes that it will be the final one that he signs.
